name: Novartis AG
reason: Adj EPS grew 8.2%/yr over 10y (USD 4.10 to 8.98) but EBIT margin is at its 10y high (31.2% vs 23.0% avg), consensus FY1 is -1.9% with LTG 6.9%, and the next decade hinges on replacing Entresto/other LOE revenue from pipeline outcomes that cannot be forecast with confidence.

name: Alcon AG
reason: Durable eye-care franchise but adj EPS rose only ~4%/yr 2019-25 (USD 1.85 to 2.37, -13% in 2025), GAAP returns are thin (10y avg ROIC 0.9%, adj-vs-GAAP gap 89%), so the >=7% route rests on consensus re-acceleration rather than record.

name: Helios Towers Plc
reason: African tower operator with net debt/EBITDA 3.8x, EPS only just positive (USD 0.03 after years of losses), share count +4.6%/yr and earnings exposed to DRC/Tanzania/Ghana currency and operator credit risk - balance sheet and FX fail the Buffett test.

name: Eurofins Scientific SE
reason: Growth has been acquisition-led (acquisitions 1.23x FCF over 10y) with net debt/EBITDA 3.0x; adj EPS is 0.7x its COVID-testing 2021 peak (EUR 3.72 vs 5.29) with 5y EPS CAGR of 0.5% and a 45% adj-vs-GAAP gap.

name: Novo Nordisk A/S
reason: Exceptional economics (10y avg ROIC 66%, EPS DKK 6.67 to 23.03) but consensus sees FY1 -4.1%, FY2 -1.7% and LTG 2.5% as GLP-1 competition from Lilly, US pricing reform and compounders make 5-10y earnings unforecastable.

name: ICON plc
reason: CRO whose demand follows biotech funding cycles; growth leaned on the PRA merger (acquisitions 1.12x FCF), adj EPS fell 10.5% in 2025 with FY1 consensus -15.6%, and the adj-vs-GAAP gap averages 174%.

name: Medicover AB
reason: Acquisition-funded growth (acquisitions 1.86x FCF) with net debt/EBITDA 3.7x, 10y avg ROIC 4.1% and erratic EPS (EUR 0.69 in 2021 to 0.08 in 2022) - growth via deals and leverage, not durable economics.

name: Shurgard Self Storage Ltd.
reason: Self-storage REIT whose FFO/share has stalled (EUR 1.735 in 2023, 1.725 in 2024, 1.737 in 2025) with consensus FY1 -4% and FY2-3 +3-6%, plus net debt/EBITDA 6.2x - no route to >=7%/yr.

name: Grupa Kety SA
reason: Aluminium extrusion/building-systems/packaging maker tied to construction cycles and aluminium spreads; GAAP EPS peaked at PLN 70.29 in 2022 and is PLN 57.45 in 2025, consensus FY1 +0.2% - a decent but cyclical, non-special business.

name: Bavarian Nordic A/S
reason: Vaccine earnings are set by lumpy government stockpiling and outbreak orders (losses in 4 of the last 11 years, EPS DKK -10.6 to 19.2) and consensus sees FY1 -31.7%, FY2 -19.4% - not forecastable.

name: Grainger plc
reason: UK residential landlord with net debt/EBITDA 11x, EPS driven by revaluations (GBP 0.31 in 2022, 0.03 in 2023), consensus FY3 -12% and rent-regulation risk from the Renters' Rights agenda.

name: Outokumpu Oyj
reason: Stainless-steel producer whose earnings are set by nickel/steel prices: EPS swung from EUR 2.41 (2022) to losses in 2023-25 and EBIT margin is -1.5%.

name: Sinch AB
reason: CPaaS roll-up (acquisitions 4.3x FCF, shares +8%/yr) with 4.4% EBIT margin, a 2022 impairment (EPS SEK -5.95) and commoditising SMS messaging - growth by acquisition with no moat.

name: Volvo Car AB
reason: Geely-controlled car OEM with EPS collapsing to SEK 0.06 in 2025 (from 5.17), EBIT margin at the 9th pctile and exposure to tariffs and the EV transition - cyclical, capital-heavy, no specialness.

name: Embracer Group AB
reason: Collapsed acquisition-driven games roll-up (shares +11%/yr, EBIT margin -48% in 2025, adj EPS 0.39 vs 9.12 SEK peak) now restructuring - hit-driven and unforecastable.

name: Adyen NV
reason: Founder-led global payments platform with adj EPS up every year (EUR 4.30 in 2018 to 33.42 in 2025, 31%/yr 5y), 25.5% avg ROIC, net cash and no acquisitions; consensus +15-24%/yr - deep dive must test take-rate pressure (Stripe) and whether FCF (1.73x conversion; LTM yield 3.1%) is inflated by merchant float.

name: Tenaris SA
reason: OCTG pipe maker whose earnings follow oil & gas drilling activity: EPS swung from USD -0.44 (2020) to 3.08 (2023) and back to 1.56, LTG 5.9%.

name: Temenos AG
reason: Core-banking software with 44.6% EBIT margin and EPS up 8/10 years, but 5y EPS CAGR is 4.1% (USD 3.43 to 4.20), 2022 fell 25.8%, there is a 55% adj-vs-GAAP gap and repeated management/accounting controversy plus cloud-migration competition.

name: Motor Oil (Hellas) Corinth Refineries SA
reason: Refiner whose earnings are set by crack spreads: adj EPS EUR 8.59 in 2022 to 3.57 in 2024, consensus FY2-3 -28%/-24%.

name: Scout24 SE
reason: Dominant German property portal (ImmoScout24) with subscription revenue: adj EPS EUR 1.03 (2016) to 3.47 (2025), up >=7% in 8/9 years incl. through the 2022-23 housing slump, 44.8% EBIT margin, net debt 0.3x, buybacks 1.6x FCF; consensus +15-18% - test AI/search disintermediation in deep dive.
